title: Episode Title: United Bets Big on Small Planes, Boeing's Wings Have a Shim Problem, and a Guy Bomb-Threats His Own Flight
summary: United is going all-in on single-aisle jets for long-haul flying while Delta calls the idea a bad product — and we dig into why that split matters. Plus, the FAA drops a wing-crack directive on Boeing's 787 that American doesn't love, American finally admits its cabins are held together with duct tape, and a guy in Detroit phones in a bomb threat because he was running late for his own flight.
